text.ja: 閉殻Hartree–Fock方程式 \hat F=\hat h+\sum_{j\in\mathrm{occ}}(2\hat J_j-\hat K_j),\qquad \hat F\phi_i=\varepsilon_i\phi_i \mathbf F\mathbf C=\mathbf S\mathbf C\boldsymbol\varepsilon,\qquad \mathbf C^\dagger\mathbf S\mathbf C=\mathbf I 閉殻RHFの占有空間軌道の式で、一般に非局所な交換を含みます。公開例は、球対称1s² Heの局所還元と、別の分子積分実装による固定入力のH₂ RHFです。原子例と分子例では基底・離散化・参照が異なります。各例の範囲は下の固定入力・検証記録で確認してください。一般多中心分子・開殻・相関を含む解法の検証ではありません。
text.en: Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations \hat F=\hat h+\sum_{j\in\mathrm{occ}}(2\hat J_j-\hat K_j),\qquad \hat F\phi_i=\varepsilon_i\phi_i \mathbf F\mathbf C=\mathbf S\mathbf C\boldsymbol\varepsilon,\qquad \mathbf C^\dagger\mathbf S\mathbf C=\mathbf I Closed-shell RHF equations for occupied spatial orbitals generally include nonlocal exchange. Published examples cover the spherical 1s²-helium local reduction and fixed-input H₂ RHF using a separate molecular-integral implementation. Their bases, discretizations and references differ; inspect each input and validation record below. These examples do not validate general multicenter molecules, open shells or correlated methods.
